io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.localization

Class PacketTranslationService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.services.localization.PacketTranslationService
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.bukkit.event.Listener

    public class PacketTranslationService
extends java.lang.Object
implements org.bukkit.event.Listener
    Rewrites outbound inventory packets so each player sees Slimefun items in their own language, without mutating the stored item. A no-op if translation.packets is disabled or no packet descriptor resolves on this server version (both leave items at their raw-id canonical = the fallback).

    • Method Detail

      • canRetitleWindows

        public boolean canRetitleWindows()
        Whether this server can retitle a vanilla container's open-window packet before it reaches the client. When false, the caller (the vanilla-container-title listener) falls back to its slower, one-tick-later setTitle correction instead.

      • notifyVanillaContainerOpen

        public void notifyVanillaContainerOpen(@Nonnull
                                       org.bukkit.entity.Player player,
                                       @Nonnull
                                       java.lang.String itemId)
        Records that player is about to receive the open-window packet for a vanilla-container SlimefunItem block with the given id, so the Netty write handler can retitle that exact packet before it reaches the client. Must be called from InventoryOpenEvent (main thread), which always fires strictly before Bukkit sends the corresponding packet. A no-op when canRetitleWindows() is false.

      • refreshDescriptions

        public void refreshDescriptions(@Nonnull
                                org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Refreshes the description-toggle preference cache for a player. Must run on the main thread: it reads the player's PDC (ItemDescriptionsOption.isEnabledFor(Player)). Called on join and whenever the player flips the toggle so the packet layer reflects it immediately.
